desired_change: Understand whether the existing audience can become a source of clients, product ideas and brand partnerships.
situation: There is already an audience, but we do not understand it well enough. We do not know which people inside it are likely to buy, what would make them act, or even which offer should come first. Possible directions include information products, advisory services and partnerships with brands. The immediate need is to learn what kind of relationship already exists before choosing what to sell or how to communicate it. We have not yet provided evidence about recurring participation, member-to-member relationships, disagreement, shared rituals or whether the audience can influence decisions.
